asset_requirements.note: No licensed Krisp Accent Conversion SDK package or vendor release identity exists in the workspace; the model is closed and proprietary.

caller_asset_contract.release_policy: A caller must supply an exact vendor release ID, but no approved vendor release, entitlement or terms record has been observed.  Structural acceptance never sets vendor_release_approved, revision_pinned or qualification.
caller_asset_contract.notes: The vendor SDK package, model bundle, runtime library, entitlement record, licence, consent, direction map, cohort manifest and target reference must exist at absolute paths and match declared SHA-256 values before a caller may process audio.  The validator never imports, links or executes a vendor artifact.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply a licensed Krisp Accent Conversion SDK package at one exact vendor release ID with a SHA-256 digest; no SDK package, source or release identity exists in the workspace.
Publish the exact model bundle name, byte count and SHA-256 for the licensed build; the merged evidence records no model digest and the model is not locally downloadable.
Record a named evaluation entitlement plus the vendor licence, evaluation terms, redistribution grant and product-use approval; no agreement or terms text has been observed.
Provide an isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock, recorded platform, ABI version and supported architectures; no Krisp environment was ever installed.
Publish the exact supported English accent direction set, stable direction identifiers, ordering and source/target semantics; the merged evidence only says selected English directions exist.
Clear input-speech, speaker-reference, consent, output-use and redistribution rights with complete notices for every evaluation clip.
Freeze a rights-cleared source-accent cohort with matched target references, language/speaker groups and held-out truth, then score content, identity, naturalness and accent movement separately.
Produce an approved exact-runtime parity vector on frozen 16 kHz mono PCM for one vendor release, including frame accounting, content delay, first output, tail and fresh-process reset.

gates.requirement: The exact vendor release ID, SDK package SHA-256, model bundle digest and runtime library identity match approved pins.
A named entitlement plus an isolated hash-pinned runtime with a recorded platform and ABI is admitted for evaluation.
Vendor licence, evaluation terms, redistribution, input-speech, speaker-reference, consent, output-use and notice requirements are cleared.
An approved exact-runtime output, frame accounting, content delay, first output and tail match the reference on frozen 16 kHz mono PCM.
Exact direction identifiers and a rights-cleared held-out cohort score accent movement, content preservation, identity and naturalness with frozen language and speaker groups.
Text/semantic preservation, identity/similarity, naturalness and alignment are reported as separate outcomes, never pooled with vendor claims.
A caller-supplied-runtime adapter is prototyped only after licence, entitlement, descriptor, ABI and independent public-surface review.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

voice_profile_requirements.requirement: Freeze permitted input and target references with rights and consent.
Freeze task, language, accent-direction and speaker groups.
Preserve text and semantic content as its own outcome.
Measure identity or similarity to the target as a separate outcome.
Measure naturalness as a separate outcome.
Record alignment, first-output and tail timing for the exact runtime.
Treat consent, reference availability and output use as independent gates.

reproduction.comparison: canonical JSON bytes and SHA-256 only; no tolerance
